dimensionBoundary: Overall reference dimensions; all stage lengths, tanks, engine bells and payload geometry are teaching approximations, not engineering measurements.
simplifications: Tank contours, all internal dimensions, stage lengths and engine/payload details are schematic.
No fuel feed plumbing, turbopumps, avionics or flight dynamics represented.
Internal blue=LOX, amber=kerosene for teaching only, not real tank paint.
Booster nose is axisymmetric simplification; does not reproduce asymmetric manufacturing shape.
Animation times are compressed teaching time, not actual mission time.

playbackContract.singleStep: Clamp each finished action at its final pose. Pause with mixer timeScale=0; seek using absolute clip time. Do not stop/reset previous component actions between sequential steps.
playbackContract.reset: Stop ALL actions, then restore defaultTransformsGLTF for every node. Reset the camera separately.
playbackContract.incompatibility: AssemblyPreview, LaunchPreview and SeparationPreview are stand-alone demonstrations. Reset first, and never mix them with per-step assembly/separation actions. LaunchPreview owns RocketRoot; the step clips do not.
playbackContract.duration: 24 fps authored. All times in seconds are pedagogical, not real mission time.

xrayNotes: Hide shellNodes; optionally hide Boosters group to see all four tanks unobstructed. Restore each visibility flag on exit.
